  • # Phase 2A — NewsSA External Automation Dispatcher Integration You are helping integrate the NewsSA content-distribution backend with Zapier in a controlled, secure, and reversible way. ## Project context NewsSA is a React/Vite news platform with a serverless backend and a database-backed content-distribution system. The backend already creates distribution jobs and individual publication records. The current system supports: * Distribution jobs * Per-platform publication records * Job status tracking * Verified callback handling * Idempotent updates * WordPress canonical article fetching * Internal job lifecycle management The external dispatcher must remain **disabled by default** until testing is complete. ## Objective Create a Zapier automation that acts as an external dispatcher for NewsSA. The Zap should: 1. Receive a signed webhook request from the NewsSA backend. 2. Validate that the request is intended for this Zap. 3. Extract the distribution job and platform information. 4. Use the supplied idempotency key to prevent duplicate processing. 5. Return or send an acknowledgement that the request was accepted. 6. Prepare the job for future platform-specific publishing. 7. Send status updates back to the NewsSA callback endpoint only when an actual processing result is available. ## Important safety requirements Do not publish to Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, or any other social platform during Phase 2A. Do not connect or request social-platform permissions yet. Do not expose or store: * Database credentials * NewsSA private keys * Internal API tokens * User passwords * Unnecessary unpublished article content Use only the minimum payload required for dispatching. The Zap must be designed so that it can be switched off without breaking NewsSA’s internal job creation system. ## Expected incoming webhook payload The NewsSA backend will send a payload similar to this: ```json { "event": "content.distribution.requested", "version": 1, "idempotency_key": "distribution-job-id", "job": { "id": "job-id", "article_id": "wordpress-article-id", "canonical_url": "https://newssa.co.za/article/example", "title": "Example article", "excerpt": "Short article summary", "featured_image_url": "https://example.com/image.jpg" }, "platforms": [ { "platform": "facebook", "publication_id": "publication-id" }, { "platform": "x", "publication_id": "publication-id" } ], "callback": { "event": "content.distribution.updated", "job_id": "job-id" }, "created_at": "2026-09-14T00:00:00.000Z" } ``` Treat the payload structure as versioned. Do not silently rename fields or invent new required fields. ## Required Zap structure Build the Zap with these stages: ### Step 1 — Catch Hook Use a webhook trigger that can receive the NewsSA dispatcher request. The webhook should capture: * Event name * Payload version * Idempotency key * Job ID * Article ID * Canonical URL * Article title * Excerpt * Featured image URL * Requested platforms * Publication IDs * Callback job ID * Creation timestamp ### Step 2 — Validate the request Add a validation step that checks: * The event equals `content.distribution.requested` * The version is supported * The job ID exists * The idempotency key exists * The canonical URL exists * At least one platform is present * The payload is not obviously malformed If validation fails, stop the Zap safely and record the reason. ### Step 3 — Idempotency protection Use the idempotency key as the unique processing key. The same idempotency key must not be processed twice. Use Zapier Storage or another appropriate Zapier-native mechanism to check whether the key has already been processed. If the key already exists: * Do not process the request again. * Do not create duplicate publication actions. * Return or record a duplicate-event result. * Keep the behavior safe and deterministic. If the key does not exist: * Store it before continuing. * Continue with the test-processing flow. ### Step 4 — Test processing only Do not publish externally in Phase 2A. Instead, create a test result containing: * Job ID * Idempotency key * Received platforms * Validation result * Processing timestamp * Status: `accepted_for_testing` This can be stored in Zapier Storage, a test table, or another safe internal Zapier step. ### Step 5 — Callback preparation Prepare a callback payload for the NewsSA backend, but do not send it unless the callback URL and authentication method have been explicitly configured and tested. The future callback structure should be similar to: ```json { "event": "content.distribution.updated", "version": 1, "job_id": "job-id", "idempotency_key": "distribution-job-id", "status": "accepted_for_testing", "publications": [], "timestamp": "2026-09-14T00:00:00.000Z" } ``` Do not claim that a social platform published anything. The status must clearly indicate that this is only a test acceptance. ## Security requirements The NewsSA backend will use a shared secret to sign requests. Support a request-signature validation design using: * HMAC-SHA256 * A timestamp * A signature header * Replay protection The preferred conceptual format is: ```text X-NewsSA-Timestamp: unix-timestamp X-NewsSA-Signature: sha256=signature ``` The signature should be calculated over: ```text timestamp + "." + raw_request_body ``` Do not hardcode the secret in visible fields, code steps, notes, or output data. If Zapier’s webhook trigger cannot securely validate the signature before parsing the body, clearly state that limitation and recommend keeping signature verification in the NewsSA backend before forwarding requests to Zapier. ## Error handling Handle these cases safely: * Missing required fields * Unsupported event version * Invalid platform data * Duplicate idempotency key * Invalid signature * Expired timestamp * Zapier Storage failure * Unexpected Zapier step failure * Callback failure * Unsupported platform The Zap must not silently mark a job as successfully published. ## Deliverables Provide: 1. The exact Zap trigger to use. 2. The required Zap steps in order. 3. The fields to map at every step. 4. The validation rules. 5. The idempotency strategy. 6. The recommended test-storage structure. 7. The callback payload structure. 8. The security limitations of the proposed Zap. 9. A test plan using fake NewsSA data only. 10. A clear list of anything that must remain disabled until Phase 2B. ## Phase 2A acceptance criteria Phase 2A is complete only when: * The Zap receives a test webhook. * The payload is validated. * Duplicate idempotency keys are rejected or safely ignored. * No real social-platform publishing occurs. * No private credentials are exposed. * Test results are recorded. * Failures are visible and understandable. * The Zap can be turned off without breaking NewsSA. * The NewsSA backend remains responsible for final publication status. * The automation is clearly marked as test-only. Do not proceed to live social-platform publishing, automatic retries, or production activation without explicit approval.

    I can help you architect and build this NewsSA dispatcher Zap. This is a sophisticated integration with important security and idempotency requirements, so let me start with a clear design overview, then we can build it step-by-step.

    Zap Architecture for Phase 2A

    Recommended Zap Structure

    Step 1 (Trigger)  → Webhooks by Zapier (Catch Hook)
Step 2 (Action)   → Code by Zapier (Signature & Payload Validation)
Step 3 (Action)   → Zapier Storage (Check Idempotency Key)
        ↓ (Paths: Branch 1: Duplicate Key / Branch 2: New Key)
Step 4a (Action)  → Zapier Storage (Log Duplicate, record result)
Step 4b (Action)  → Zapier Storage (Store Idempotency Key)
Step 5b (Action)  → Code by Zapier (Build Test Result)
Step 6b (Action)  → Zapier Storage (Record Test Result)
Step 7b (Action)  → Code by Zapier (Prepare Callback Payload - not sent yet)

    Key Design Decisions

    1. Webhook Trigger ✓

    • Tool: Webhooks by Zapier (Catch Hook)
    • Capture: The trigger will receive the raw JSON payload
    • Limitation: Zapier's standard Webhooks trigger does not natively validate HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
      • ⚠️ You must validate the signature in a Code step (Step 2) before trusting the payload.
      • Alternatively, keep signature validation in the NewsSA backend before forwarding to Zapier (recommended for Phase 2A to reduce risk).

    2. Signature Validation ✓

    • Method: Code by Zapier (JavaScript or Python)
    • Approach:
      • Extract X-NewsSA-Timestamp and X-NewsSA-Signature headers from the webhook
      • Verify timestamp is within acceptable window (e.g., ±5 min to prevent replay attacks)
      • Compute HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.raw_body using shared secret
      • Compare computed signature with header signature (constant-time comparison)
      • Stop safely if validation fails (output error reason for logging)

    3. Idempotency Protection ✓

    • Mechanism: Zapier Storage (Key-Value)
    • Key: The idempotency_key from the payload
    • Strategy:
      • Step 3: Query Zapier Storage with the key
      • Step 3a (Path - Duplicate Branch): If key exists, log as duplicate, do not process further
      • Step 3b (Path - New Key Branch): If key does not exist, proceed
      • Step 4b: Store the key with metadata (timestamp, job_id) before processing
      • This ensures idempotency even if the same request arrives twice

    4. Validation Logic ✓

    • Method: Code by Zapier
    • Checks:
      • event === "content.distribution.requested"
      • version === 1 (future: handle version negotiation)
      • job.id is non-empty string
      • idempotency_key is non-empty
      • job.canonical_url is a valid URL
      • platforms array has at least 1 item
      • Each platform has platform and publication_id fields
      • No suspicious/malformed data
      • Return: { valid: true, errors: [] } or { valid: false, errors: ["reason1", "reason2"] }

    5. Test-Only Processing ✓

    • Action: Code by Zapier (Build test result object)
    • Output: json { "job_id": "job-id", "idempotency_key": "distribution-job-id", "platforms_received": ["facebook", "x"], "publications_received": ["pub-id-1", "pub-id-2"], "validation_result": "passed", "processing_timestamp": "ISO-8601-timestamp", "status": "accepted_for_testing", "processing_note": "Phase 2A: No actual publishing performed" }
    • Storage: Save to Zapier Storage under a test results namespace

    6. Callback Preparation ✓

    • Action: Code by Zapier (Prepare callback structure)
    • Output (not sent): json { "event": "content.distribution.updated", "version": 1, "job_id": "job-id", "idempotency_key": "distribution-job-id", "status": "accepted_for_testing", "publications": [], "processing_timestamp": "ISO-8601-timestamp", "note": "Phase 2A testing only. No platforms published." }
    • Note: Do NOT send this callback yet—store it for manual inspection during testing.

    Exact Steps & Field Mappings

    Step Type App Action Key Fields
    1 Trigger Webhooks by Zapier Catch Hook Captures raw webhook body + headers
    2 Action Code by Zapier JavaScript Validate signature, extract fields, validate payload
    3 Action Zapier Storage Get Record Lookup idempotency key
    3a Path (Duplicate) Filter / Paths Custom Rules If idempotency key exists
    3b Path (New) Filter / Paths Custom Rules If idempotency key does not exist
    4a Action Zapier Storage Create Record Log duplicate event (branch 3a)
    4b Action Zapier Storage Create Record Store new idempotency key (branch 3b)
    5b Action Code by Zapier JavaScript Build test result object (branch 3b)
    6b Action Zapier Storage Create Record Store test result (branch 3b)
    7b Action Code by Zapier JavaScript Prepare callback payload (branch 3b) — optional, for review

    Security Limitations & Recommendations

    Limitation Impact Mitigation
    Zapier webhook trigger doesn't validate HMAC-SHA256 natively Signature must be validated manually in Code step Implement signature validation in Code step OR validate in NewsSA backend before sending
    Shared secret cannot be stored visibly in Zapier Risk of accidental exposure Use Zapier Storage or a secure environment variable (Pro feature); do NOT hardcode in Code step
    Webhook URL is semi-public once deployed Replay attacks possible Implement timestamp validation (±5 min window) in Code step
    Zapier Storage has rate limits Could bottleneck high-volume requests For Phase 2A, acceptable; plan caching strategy for production
    Error logs visible in Zap history Sensitive info risk Use generic error codes in outputs; keep details in separate secure logs

    Phase 2A Recommendation: Keep signature validation in the NewsSA backend for now, and rely on Zapier to forward only validated requests. This reduces complexity in the Zap and keeps the secret credential outside Zapier.

    Test-Only Recording Strategy

    Zapier Storage Structure (Recommended)

    Namespace 1: newssa_idempotency_keys

    Key: "{idempotency_key}"
Value: {
  "stored_at": "ISO-8601",
  "job_id": "...",
  "status": "processing"
}

    Namespace 2: newssa_test_results

    Key: "{job_id}_{timestamp}"
Value: {
  "job_id": "...",
  "idempotency_key": "...",
  "platforms_requested": ["facebook", "x"],
  "validation_result": "passed|failed",
  "errors": [],
  "status": "accepted_for_testing",
  "timestamp": "ISO-8601"
}

    Error Handling Matrix

    Scenario Action Output Continue?
    Signature invalid Stop in Code step { error: "INVALID_SIGNATURE", code: 401 } ❌ NO
    Timestamp too old Stop in Code step { error: "REQUEST_EXPIRED", code: 401 } ❌ NO
    Event type mismatch Stop in Code step { error: "UNSUPPORTED_EVENT", code: 400 } ❌ NO
    Required fields missing Stop in Code step { error: "INVALID_PAYLOAD", details: [...], code: 400 } ❌ NO
    Idempotency key duplicate Log as duplicate, do NOT process { status: "duplicate_accepted", idempotency_key: "...", code: 202 } ❌ NO
    Zapier Storage unavailable Stop gracefully { error: "STORAGE_ERROR", code: 503 } ❌ NO
    Unexpected Code error Catch and log { error: "INTERNAL_ERROR", code: 500 } ❌ NO

    Phase 2A Acceptance Checklist

    • Webhook trigger created and URL copied
    • Test webhook sent from NewsSA backend (or simulated locally)
    • Signature validation working (if implemented in Zap) or confirmed in backend
    • Payload validation passes for valid test data
    • Payload validation fails cleanly for malformed test data
    • Idempotency key stored on first request
    • Duplicate request (same key) rejected safely, no re-processing
    • Test result recorded in Zapier Storage
    • No real social-platform publishing occurred
    • Error cases logged with clear reasons
    • Callback payload prepared (not sent) and reviewed
    • Zap can be toggled off without breaking NewsSA's internal job system
    • Phase 2A label/comment added to Zap for clarity

    Phase 2B Prerequisites (Disabled Until Approval)

    ❌ DO NOT build these yet:

    • Actual social-platform publishing (Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube)
    • OAuth connections to social platforms
    • Automatic retry logic for failed publishes
    • Live callback sending to NewsSA
    • Production idempotency key cleanup
    • Analytics or reporting on published content
